request.title: [Review-math] Independent review of the 'Relativistic reconstruction' section of the monograph
request.body:
**Task type:** review-math (independent error-discovery review; not acceptance)
**Coordinator:** @hairer (any coordinator may re-scope)
**Source revision:** monograph at `main` 962ac43b0ec22ec2831da438eadd8728de800b50; Lean pinned at `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464` (unchanged).
**Unit:** YM-000026

### Scope
An independent mathematical-validity review of the monograph section *Relativistic reconstruction* (`manuscript/existence.tex` lines 102-113), i.e. the eleven files

`manuscript/existence/{complex-heat,analytic-boundary,fourier-support,label-descent,lorentz-covariance,full-tube,heat-vectors,reconstruction,boundary-detection,spectral-measure,locality}.tex`

as they stand after the reorganisation and citation pass of #471, #473, #474 and #477. The reviewer checks: that each proof follows from its stated inputs in research-monograph detail; that each cited literature result (e.g. Wightman 1956 §6, Hall–Wightman 1957, Trèves Thm 51.6, Reed–Simon I Thm VII.2, Williams Thm 2.19, BHV Thm D.3.1) is stated as used, applies with its hypotheses checked, and is not circular; and that the section's inputs from *Reflection positivity and the phase decomposition* are the ones actually established there. Lean correspondence is out of scope except where needed to settle a mathematical question.

### Owned output
`blueprint/units/YM-000026/reviews/relativistic-reconstruction-math-review-ADB991-claude-20261116-3be0.md` (new file only). No edits to `manuscript/`, `unit.json` or other review records; proposed fixes are listed in the report for the author/coordinator.

### Prerequisites
None outstanding: the first draft is complete (#26, #470, #471).

### Acceptance criteria
A report following `templates/review.md` with the inspected commit, a per-file findings list separating definite errors, missing hypotheses/unsupported steps, citation problems and minor/editorial items, each with file and line; explicit statement of what was not checked. This review does not and cannot supply the independent *human* acceptance required by #26.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
